==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:; (Appears after completing [[Daybreak at Last]])
:'''Ganquan:''' Hi, {{Rover}}!
:'''Ganquan:''' You know what!
:'''Ganquan:''' I finally managed to borrow the recording of the Riverside Games from ten years ago!
:{{DIcon}} Wasn't it checked out by someone else?
:'''Ganquan:''' Yeah, and they just returned it to the archives recently.
:'''Ganquan:''' Since they're holding the Riverside Games again soon, I wanted to see if the recording was returned.
:'''Ganquan:''' And surprise! It was!
:'''Ganquan:''' But man, gotta say the video quality sucks... All backs and no faces at all. Thought I could finally admire how cool they looked.
:{{DIcon}} You've already met [[Jiyan|one of them]].
:'''Ganquan:''' What? When? How?
:{{DIcon}} That's a secret.
:'''Ganquan:''' Come on, {{Rover}}, just tell me!
:'''Ganquan:''' I could really use some advice from them...
:{{DIcon}} The injured soldiers... Are they alright?
:'''Ganquan:''' Yes they are! They're all fully recovered. Thank you for asking.
:'''Ganquan:''' And... There's another thing, {{Rover}}...
:'''Ganquan:''' Erm, you know they're gonna hold another Riverside Games, right? Lingyan and I want to join the race with our original teammates this time.
:{{DIcon}} Sure. I understand.
:'''Ganquan:''' Thank you, {{Rover}}! Promise you'll come cheer for us, alright?
:{{DIcon}} I promise.
{{Dialogue End}}
